h1: 해커스 어법 제대로 CHAPTER 05 · p.62 어법변형문제 정답 및 해설

groups.quick:
빠른정답
1) developed → had developed / 2) to accepting → to accept / 3) doesn't exist → didn't exist / 4) which → who / 5) would almost certainly succeed → will almost certainly succeed / 6) received → had received

items.pre: If someone were able to read other people's minds, would he or she still get along with friends and family? Absolutely not. If people knew too much about other people's thoughts, their relationships may become difficult. In fact, people would have understood each other better if humans
items.correct: If someone were able to read other people's minds, would he or she still get along with friends and family? Absolutely not. If people knew too much about other people's thoughts, their relationships may become difficult. In fact, people would have understood each other better if humans had developed this ability sooner.
items.interp: 만약 누군가가 다른 사람의 마음을 읽을 수 있다면, 그 사람은 여전히 친구와 가족과 잘 지낼 수 있을까? 결코 그렇지 않을 것이다. 만약 사람들이 다른 사람들의 생각에 대해 너무 많이 안다면, 그들의 관계는 어려워질 수도 있다. 실제로, 만약 인류가 이 능력을 더 일찍 발달시켰더라면 사람들은 서로를 더 잘 이해했을 것이다.
items.badge: 가정법 과거 vs. 가정법 과거완료 (Chapter 05 POINT 1)
items.explain: 주절이 would have understood로 가정법 과거완료를 쓰고 있으므로 if절도 단순과거가 아니라 과거완료로 나타내야 한다. 따라서 developed가 아니라 had developed가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: If you look closely at the history of the world, you will find some inventions that have changed history forever. Scientists devoted years to developing weapons that they hoped would end the war quickly, but few were prepared
items.correct: If you look closely at the history of the world, you will find some inventions that have changed history forever. For example, the result of World War II might have been different if the atomic bomb had not been developed. Scientists devoted years to developing weapons that they hoped would end the war quickly, but few were prepared to accept the consequences.
items.interp: 만약 당신이 세계 역사를 자세히 살펴본다면, 역사를 영원히 바꾼 몇몇 발명품들을 발견하게 될 것이다. 예를 들어, 만약 원자폭탄이 개발되지 않았더라면 제2차 세계대전의 결과는 달랐을지도 모른다. 과학자들은 전쟁을 빨리 끝내기를 바랐던 무기를 개발하는 데 수년을 바쳤지만, 그 결과를 받아들일 준비가 된 사람은 거의 없었다.
items.badge: 전치사 to vs. to부정사의 to (Chapter 06 POINT 4)
items.explain: be prepared to는 전치사 to가 아니라 to부정사의 to를 취하는 표현이므로 뒤에는 동명사가 아니라 동사원형이 와야 한다. 따라서 to accepting이 아니라 to accept가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: Too many companies advertise their products as if they had no competitors. If there were no competitors in the market, those companies would survive, but that rarely happens in reality. Their marketing teams often act as if the competition
items.correct: Too many companies advertise their products as if they had no competitors. If there were no competitors in the market, those companies would survive, but that rarely happens in reality. Their marketing teams often act as if the competition didn't exist at all.
items.interp: 너무 많은 회사들이 마치 경쟁자가 없는 것처럼 자사 제품을 광고한다. 만약 시장에 경쟁자가 없다면, 그 회사들은 살아남을 것이다, 하지만 그런 일은 현실에서 거의 일어나지 않는다. 그들의 마케팅팀은 종종 마치 경쟁이 전혀 존재하지 않는 것처럼 행동한다.
items.explain: as if 뒤에 이어지는 내용이 사실과 다른 것을 반대로 가정하며 act와 동시에 일어나는 상황을 나타내므로 현재시제 doesn't exist가 아니라 과거시제로 가정법을 나타내야 한다. 따라서 doesn't exist가 아니라 didn't exist가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: If Amy hadn't avoided last week's interview because of her fear of failure, she might have gotten her dream job. You will achieve much more in life if you accept that failure is sometimes normal. This is a lesson especially important for people
items.post: struggle with the fear of failure.
items.correct: If Amy hadn't avoided last week's interview because of her fear of failure, she might have gotten her dream job. You will achieve much more in life if you accept that failure is sometimes normal. This is a lesson especially important for people who struggle with the fear of failure.
items.interp: 만약 Amy가 실패에 대한 두려움 때문에 지난주 면접을 피하지 않았더라면, 그녀는 꿈꾸던 직장을 얻었을지도 모른다. 만약 당신이 실패가 때때로 정상적이라는 것을 받아들인다면 인생에서 훨씬 더 많은 것을 이룰 것이다. 이것은 실패에 대한 두려움과 씨름하는 사람들에게 특히 중요한 교훈이다.
items.explain: 선행사 people은 사람이므로 사물을 가리키는 관계대명사 which가 아니라 사람을 가리키는 관계대명사 who를 써야 한다.

items.pre: Thomas speaks Chinese as if he had learned it when he was young, but he only learned it recently. He has a great talent for languages, so if he had chosen a language other than Chinese, he would have mastered it very quickly, too. If he decides to learn a third language next year, he
items.correct: Thomas speaks Chinese as if he had learned it when he was young, but he only learned it recently. He has a great talent for languages, so if he had chosen a language other than Chinese, he would have mastered it very quickly, too. If he decides to learn a third language next year, he will almost certainly succeed quickly.
items.interp: Thomas는 마치 어렸을 때 배운 것처럼 중국어를 말하지만, 그는 사실 최근에야 그것을 배웠다. 그는 언어에 대단한 재능이 있어서, 만약 그가 중국어가 아닌 다른 언어를 선택했더라면 그것도 아주 빨리 마스터했을 것이다. 만약 그가 내년에 제3외국어를 배우기로 결심한다면, 그는 거의 확실히 빠르게 성공할 것이다.
items.explain: if he decides to learn a third language next year는 실제로 일어날 가능성이 있는 단순 조건을 나타내는 부사절이므로 주절에는 would가 아니라 will이 와야 한다. 따라서 would almost certainly succeed가 아니라 will almost certainly succeed가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: If more students knew that their present efforts could change their future, they would focus on their current studies, but it's a pity that they don't know it. Students will have better options for deciding their future career paths if they perform better in school at the moment. Many teachers believe that students would have performed even better if they
items.post: more personalized guidance earlier in their education.
items.correct: If more students knew that their present efforts could change their future, they would focus on their current studies, but it's a pity that they don't know it. Students will have better options for deciding their future career paths if they perform better in school at the moment. Many teachers believe that students would have performed even better if they had received more personalized guidance earlier in their education.
items.interp: 만약 더 많은 학생들이 현재의 노력이 그들의 미래를 바꿀 수 있다는 것을 안다면, 그들은 현재의 학업에 집중할 것이다, 하지만 안타깝게도 그들은 그것을 알지 못한다. 만약 학생들이 지금 학교에서 더 잘한다면 그들은 미래의 진로를 결정하는 데 있어 더 나은 선택지를 가지게 될 것이다. 많은 교사들은 만약 학생들이 교육 초기에 더 많은 맞춤형 지도를 받았더라면 학생들이 훨씬 더 잘 해냈을 것이라고 믿는다.

items.explain: 주절이 would have performed로 가정법 과거완료를 쓰고 있으므로 if절도 단순과거가 아니라 과거완료로 나타내야 한다. 따라서 received가 아니라 had received가 되어야 한다.
